blurb: This check confirms that a fully-mirrored rootvg lists at least two normal-mode boot devices, so the box can still boot from the surviving mirror copy after a disk is lost. It only applies when rootvg is fully mirrored across two or more disks — on an unmirrored box it reports not-applicable, and when the boot list cannot be read (for example when not running as root) it warns. A rootvg whose layout probes fail to return a readable layout is not assessed.
